title: Junior Selection Committee Convenes to Discuss Player Progress
indian_angle: This update informs fans about the ongoing process of selecting and nurturing India's future badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India's Junior Selection Committee held a meeting today to review player performances and discuss future selections.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The formation of this committee ensures that Indian players will have a direct voice in the governance and development of badminton in the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players to contribute to decision-making processes.

title: National Coaching Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, a key international event.
summary: A national coaching camp is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare Indian shuttlers for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Organizes Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: Investing in advanced coaching education directly benefits Indian badminton by improving the quality of training for players across the nation.
summary: The BAI is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, focusing on enhancing coaching standards.

title: Indian Junior Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for developing young Indian talent and preparing them to compete against the best in Asia at the U17 and U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This change in scoring format for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic events will significantly impact how young Indian players train and compete.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
